capabilities: suggest inline completions as ghost text while typing
accept suggestions word-by-word with Tab or a mobile toolbar command
switch between completion providers (OpenAI, Groq, AI21, goose.ai, Ollama)
save settings as presets exposed as global editor commands
toggle completion from the command palette
extras: Recommends Groq (free as of end of May 2024) or a local Ollama model to lower latency and cost; troubleshooting is handled via GitHub issues rather than in the README.
intentEvidence: providing suggestions in ghost text that can be accepted or ignored by the you as you see fit, similar to what github copilot does
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI-powered completion while writing, so suggestions must come from an external tool or manual prompting.

relations.evidence: my own fork of saminzadeh's awesome codemirror-extension-inline-suggestion

requires.name: OpenAI, Groq, AI21, or goose.ai API key

summary: AI autocomplete plugin that shows word and sentence completions as ghost text using OpenAI ChatGPT/GPT-3, Groq, AI21, goose.ai, or local Ollama models.
